hookBytePolicy: borrowed dataptr bytes; linear write prewrite, linear read postread, page-walk physical A/D write postwrite
coverage: CPU instrumentation callbacks only; no complete physical bus, MMIO, DMA, or cycle equivalence
ramSnapshotDomain: fixed plain owned low RAM only; not bus events

checkpoint.boundary: after final E9 marker OUT, before next fixture instruction

pde0.source: checkpoint plain RAM snapshot, not a hook event

pte5.source: checkpoint plain RAM snapshot, not a hook event

data5.source: checkpoint plain RAM snapshot, not a hook event
